role: Meta-gate: every scripts/*.sh (except itself) must not call mktemp directly, must guard each gate_mktemp call with `|| exit`, and must source only existing helper paths.
toplevel: cd to repo root. Python over scripts/*.sh: rule 1 non-# lines matching bare `mktemp` without gate_mktemp; rule 2 lines containing gate_mktemp (not # lines) without '|| exit'; rule 3 `source "$(dirname "$0")/X"` where scripts/X missing. Failures -> exit 1; else clean with counts. Does not scan scripts/lib/ or Python scripts. Wired: gates.yml, ci.yml, Makefile gate-preflight.
